whenToUse: A focused task that keeps context: new contact, insert link, invite members, leave request.
Short forms with a fixed header/footer and scrolling body.
avoidWhen: Quick edit or preview with the list still visible — use Sheet.
Long multi-section editing — use a full page.
a11y: Always render a DialogTitle (visually hidden if needed); focus is trapped and returned.
The close guard warns before discarding unsaved changes.
